posts.title: When I Grow Up: Taxidermist Mickel van Leeuwen of “Inside Out Animals”
posts.description: Almost twenty years ago, on July 21, 2006, a young humpback whale was discovered in the Gulf of Riga in the Baltic Sea, near the coast of Dunte, Latvia.
